goals.title: namei path resolution with ., .., trailing-slash and mount-crossing rules
goals.criterion: make test_vfs_path green: 200-case table (relative, absolute, /a/b/../c, //, trailing /, empty) resolves to the expected vnode; resolving '..' at a mount root returns the mount root vnode, not the parent filesystem's; a path crossing two mounts lands in the second mount's root inode

goals.title: per-process file descriptor table with dup/fcntl/O_CLOEXEC semantics
goals.criterion: make test_vfs_fd green: fd alloc is lowest-free, dup(3) yields two fds sharing one open-file struct, close of one leaves the other valid, F_SETFD FD_CLOEXEC causes the fd to close on exec, and fd exhaustion returns EMFILE at RLIMIT_NOFILE without corrupting the table

goals.title: readv/writev/pread/pwrite through the VFS fops layer
goals.criterion: make test_vfs_io green: a 7-element iovec write followed by a 7-element read round-trips 64 KiB byte-identical; pread does not advance the file offset; a partial write of 3 of 10 elements returns the byte count actually written and the file offset reflects it

goals.title: symlinks: create, readlink, and follow with an ELOOP depth cap
goals.criterion: make test_vfs_link green: a symlink created in RAM-FS reads back its target exactly; a self-referential chain and a 10-deep cycle both fail with ELOOP after 8 follows (not a stack overflow); a symlink pointing into another mount resolves across the mount boundary

goals.title: per-mount case-sensitivity policy with FAT32 forcing insensitive lookup
goals.criterion: make test_vfs_case green: a case-sensitive mount distinguishes 'README' from 'readme' (two distinct inodes); a case-insensitive FAT32 mount opens 'ReadMe.TXT' for an entry stored as 'README.TXT'; the policy flag is readable per mount via statvfs

goals.title: statvfs: f_bsize, f_blocks, f_bfree, f_bavail, f_namemax per mount
goals.criterion: make test_vfs_statvfs green: on a 16 MiB FAT32 image f_blocks * f_frsize == image size and f_bfree matches fat32_count_free() * cluster_size to the byte; f_namemax is 255 for FAT32 with LFN and 8.3 without; 'df' output for a mounted TXFS shows non-zero capacity

goals.title: atomic rename with RENAME_EXCHANGE and RENAME_NOREPLACE
goals.criterion: make test_vfs_rename green: RENAME_EXCHANGE swaps two existing names in one call with no window where either is absent (kill -9 mid-loop leaves both present); RENAME_NOREPLACE returns EEXIST instead of clobbering; overwriting a non-empty directory returns ENOTEMPTY

goals.title: FAT32 large-file support: 64-bit offsets and files over 4 GiB
goals.criterion: make test_fat32 green: a 5 GiB file is written and read back in 1 MiB chunks with a final md5 match, fat32_seek(fd, 0, SEEK_END) reports the exact byte size > 4 GiB, and cluster-chain walking uses 64-bit LBA arithmetic with no 32-bit truncation (checked by a forced 5 GiB image on a sparse file)

goals.title: FAT32 directory iteration as a resumable readdir cookie/handle
goals.criterion: make test_fat32 green: readdir on a 5000-entry directory returns each entry exactly once across many small-buffer calls (cookie resumes mid-cluster), includes . and .. on the first two calls, and skips deleted and volume-label entries; no LFN entry is ever returned as a standalone file

goals.title: FAT32 rmdir with non-empty rejection and recursive removal
goals.criterion: make test_fat32 green: rmdir on a directory holding a file returns ENOTEMPTY and leaves it intact; after the child is deleted rmdir succeeds and its cluster chain is freed (fat32_count_free returns to the pre-create value); rmdir on '.' or '..' returns EINVAL

goals.title: FAT32 fsck repair executor: lost chains, cross-links, orphan clusters
goals.criterion: make test_fat_fsck green: a deliberately corrupted image with a cross-linked cluster pair and an orphan chain of 7 clusters is repaired to zero errors on a second pass; each orphan chain is recovered as FILE0000.CHK..FILE000N.CHK with contents byte-identical to the original chain bytes; the FAT copies are re-mirrored to match

goals.title: FAT32 defragmentation: cluster relinking that preserves directory entries
goals.criterion: make test_fat_defrag green: an image with a fragmented 200-cluster file is compacted so the file's chain is contiguous, every directory entry and file content is unchanged (full image md5 of all file data matches pre-run), and the run reports the number of cluster moves performed

goals.title: FAT32 FSInfo free-cluster count mirror kept authoritative
goals.criterion: make test_fat32 green: after 1000 create/delete cycles fat32_info() reports the FSInfo free count equal to the count obtained by walking the FAT; a stale FSInfo free count is detected and rewritten on flush; a zero/invalid FSInfo signature falls back to a full FAT scan rather than trusting the field

goals.title: FAT12/FAT16 mounted through the same driver as FAT32
goals.criterion: make test_fat2 green: FAT12, FAT16 and FAT32 images created by the formatter all mount, create a file, write 1 MiB, and read it back byte-identical; wubu_fat2_type() returns 12/16/32 for each and the cluster-chain walker uses the correct next-cluster width per type

goals.title: FAT32 timestamps with 10 ms granularity and local-time interpretation
goals.criterion: make test_fat32 green: two writes within the same second produce distinct 10 ms fields; wubu_fat2_epoch() and the inverse wubu_fat2_dos_time() round-trip 1000 seeded epochs across 1970..2107 with zero drift; the year 2107 boundary and the 1980 FAT epoch floor are handled without wraparound

goals.title: FAT32 volume label, serial, and boot-sector self-repair on mount
goals.criterion: make test_fat32 green: a label written via the mount table appears in the root directory with the ATTR_VOLUME_ID bit and is not enumerable as a file; an image with a zeroed signature field is repaired (signature 0xAA55 and a valid boot jump rewritten) before mounting instead of being rejected

goals.title: TXFS mounted as the root filesystem over a block device
goals.criterion: make test_txfs green: a 32 MiB loop-backed image is formatted, mounted as /, and booted from in the hosted harness; a file created, synced, and read back after a simulated power cut returns the post-commit contents; the QEMU boot log shows 'txfs: root mounted, journal replay N records'

goals.title: TXFS extent-mapped inodes with 64-bit file sizes
goals.criterion: make test_txfs green: a file grown past 4 GiB maps through an extent tree with no 32-bit overflow; stat() reports the exact size; the inode holds at most 4 inline extents and spills to a tree beyond that; free-space accounting stays consistent after 500 grow/shrink cycles

goals.title: TXFS directory B-tree index with insert, delete, and rebalance
goals.criterion: make test_txfs green: a 50,000-entry directory keeps lookup depth <= 4 after sequential and random insertion, random deletion of 50% keeps the tree balanced (all leaves at equal depth), and every inserted name is found while every deleted name is absent; a 0-byte and a 255-byte name both hash into the tree correctly

goals.title: TXFS journal replay under torn-tail and partial-commit corruption
goals.criterion: make test_txfs green: 200 randomized crash points across a 1000-op workload each replay to either the pre- or post-commit state with no lost acknowledged write and no partially applied transaction; replay is idempotent (a second replay of the same journal is a no-op); txfs_applied_count() equals txfs_committed_count() after recovery

goals.title: TXFS copy-on-write snapshots with a reflink-style clone
goals.criterion: make test_txfs green: after a snapshot, writes to the original copy-on-write new extents and the snapshot's data is byte-identical to pre-write; 1000 clones of a 1 MiB file add under 2 MiB of disk usage; deleting the original frees only extents no snapshot references (refcount-checked)

goals.title: TXFS quota enforcement: per-uid block and inode limits
goals.criterion: make test_txfs_quota green: a uid capped at 1000 blocks gets EDQUOT on the write that would exceed it, a different uid is unaffected, and after deleting files below the cap writes succeed again; quota accounting survives a remount and a crash-recovery replay

goals.title: TXFS permission bits and uid/gid enforced through the VFS
goals.criterion: make test_txfs green: a 0600 file owned by uid 1000 rejects open() from uid 1001 with EACCES and permits it from uid 0; chmod 0644 flips the decision without touching contents; the execute bit on a file with no read bit still permits execve; permission is checked in the VFS fops path, not per-FS

goals.title: TXFS online extent defragmentation and free-space compaction
goals.criterion: make test_txfs green: an image fragmented by 500 interleaved writes is compacted while mounted, the total number of extents drops by >= 60%, all file contents are verified byte-identical afterward, and concurrent reads during compaction never observe a torn block

goals.title: TXFS fsck-style repair: orphan inode reclamation and bad-extent pruning
goals.criterion: make test_txfs green: an image with 3 unreferenced inodes and 1 out-of-range extent pointer is repaired to a clean second-pass report, unreferenced inodes land in lost+found with correct data, and an extent beyond the device end is dropped rather than crashing the walker

goals.title: TXFS inline small-file data stored inside the inode
goals.criterion: make test_txfs green: a file <= 60 bytes allocates zero data blocks (free-space count unchanged after create), reads back exactly, and grows past 60 bytes by migrating to extents without losing a byte; the on-disk inode stays at a fixed 256 bytes

goals.title: 9P attach/walk over the real kernel mount table
goals.criterion: make test_ns_9p green: Twalk from / to a file under a mounted TXFS returns the correct qid, and a Twalk that crosses a mount boundary returns the mounted filesystem's root qid; Tattach on a nonexistent tree returns ENOENT; the walk is namespace-scoped so a process without the attach cannot see the tree at all

goals.title: 9P Tlock/Tunlock byte-range file locking over the 9P path
goals.criterion: make test_ns_9p green: two clients attaching the same file, the second Tlock on an overlapping byte range blocks until the first Tlocks's unlock, non-overlapping ranges proceed concurrently, and a client that vanishes has its locks released (no deadlock on the next lock request)

goals.title: /n/fs namespace tree: live per-mount stats and the mount table
goals.criterion: make test_ns_9p green: 'cat /n/fs/mounts' lists every mount with source, target and fstype; 'cat /n/fs/mounts/0/stats' reports blocks/free/reads/writes that change after a write; 'find /n -name' enumerates the tree; a read of the stats file reflects a write performed 1 ms earlier

goals.title: 9P2000.L create/unlink/mkdir/renameat semantics matched to the VFS
goals.criterion: make test_ns_9p green: Tcreate with DMDIR makes a directory, with mode 0600 sets the permission bits on the underlying TXFS inode, Trenameat replaces a file and returns EEXIST when the target exists and the flag forbids it, and Tunlink of a non-empty directory fails EISDIR; every mutation is visible to a second attached client immediately

goals.title: 9P iounit handling and message fragmentation above 8 KiB
goals.criterion: make test_styx green: a 4 MiB read over 9P is split into iounit-sized messages with no message exceeding msize, the concatenated bytes match the file exactly, and a client that advertises a 4 KiB msize still completes a 1 MiB transfer; the decoder rejects a message with a size field larger than msize

goals.title: synthetic /n/fs/snapshots directory listing live TXFS snapshots
goals.criterion: make test_ns_9p green: creating a TXFS snapshot makes a new directory appear under /n/fs/snapshots without a daemon restart; reading a file through the snapshot path returns the snapshot's content, not the live file's; deleting the snapshot removes the directory entry

goals.title: 9P auth-phase rejection with a capability gate on Tattach
goals.criterion: make test_ns_9p green: a Tauth request on a no-auth server returns ENOTSUP and never allocates a fid; a Tattach without the required namespace capability is refused with EPERM; the refusal is logged at /n/kernel/klog and a successful attach is logged with the fid and tree name

goals.title: mount(2)/umount(2) semantics with EBUSY on active use
goals.criterion: make test_mount green: umount with an open file or a cwd inside the tree returns EBUSY and leaves the entry intact; MS_RDONLY makes every write path return EROFS while reads succeed; mounting over a non-empty directory hides (does not delete) the underlying entries and they reappear on umount

goals.title: block-device cache with dirty writeback and barrier-ordered flush
goals.criterion: make test_hw_bcache green: a write-heavy workload shows >= 85% hit rate on the re-read of a 64 MiB working set on a 4 MiB cache; a dirty block is never re-read as stale before its writeback completes; an ordered barrier (FUA/FLUSH) forces all preceding dirty blocks out before the post-barrier write reaches the device (verified by an instrumented backend driver)

goals.title: MBR and GPT partition parsing with automatic mount of known filesystems
goals.criterion: make test_gpt green: an MBR image with 4 primary partitions yields the right start/size per entry and correct type-code detection; a GPT image with a protective MBR and 128 entries parses its GUID and LBA range, a corrupt CRC32 in the GPT header is rejected, and a partition holding FAT32 is auto-mounted

goals.title: page-cache-backed mmap of a filesystem file with write-back
goals.criterion: make test_vmm green: mmap of a 1 MiB TXFS file returns pages served from the page cache (a second mmap of the same file hits cache), a MAP_SHARED store is visible to a read() on another fd after msync, and unmapping writes back dirty pages so a later open sees the new bytes; the pmem/DAX fast path on wubu_dax.c bypasses the copy for aligned maps

goals.title: fsync/fdatasync/msync plus O_SYNC and O_DIRECT semantics
goals.criterion: make test_swap green: fsync guarantees durability against a simulated power cut (data present after remount), fdatasync skips a pure-metadata write, msync(MS_SYNC) flushes a mapped range, O_DIRECT bypasses the block cache (verified by a hit counter that does not increment), and O_SYNC writes complete only after the device reports the write

goals.title: swap file backed by a TXFS extent instead of a raw partition
goals.criterion: make test_swap green: a swapfile created on TXFS is activated, swapon reports its size and priority, pages written to it are read back identical after swapoff/on, and a page fault storm does not corrupt the journal (TXFS replay after unplug is clean)

goals.title: trash and undelete for the real filesystem, not just the GUI
goals.criterion: make test_trash green: unlinking a file on a TXFS mount moves it to .trash/<inode>.<timestamp> and a restore reads it back byte-identical with its original name, mode and mtime; .trash is invisible to readdir of the parent and to 9P Treaddir; a GC frees entries past the size/age cap

goals.title: ISO9660 reader: PVD, path table, and directory-record walking
goals.criterion: make test_iso_read green: an ISO image built by iso_builder_write_file() is mounted and every file is read back byte-identical; the Rock Ridge extension is ignored when absent and the path table is used for lookup; a bad primary-volume-descriptor magic is rejected with a clear error rather than read as garbage

goals.title: ISO9660 Joliet and Rock Ridge extension readers
goals.criterion: make test_iso_read green: a Joliet-encoded image yields UTF-16 long names decoded to UTF-8 exactly; a Rock Ridge image yields POSIX mode bits, uid/gid and symlink targets; an image with neither extension falls back to strict 8.3 uppercase names with a ';1' version suffix stripped

goals.title: Unicode filenames: NFC normalization and casefold on name compare
goals.criterion: make test_vfs_utf8 green: creating 'e' with U+0301 and creating 'e-acute' precomposed are treated as the same name (NFC-normalized, second returns EEXIST on an insensitive mount), the stored name round-trips as valid UTF-8, invalid byte sequences are rejected with EILSEQ instead of stored, and a full-width/ASCII casefold pair resolves on a casefold mount

goals.title: TRIM/discard integration on SSD-backed mounts and free extents
goals.criterion: make test_hw_trim green: freeing a TXFS extent issues a discard for its LBAs (verified by a recording backend that logs TRIM ranges), batched discards coalesce adjacent ranges into one command, a device reporting TRIM unsupported silently skips it, and no discard is issued for a block still referenced by a snapshot

goals.title: hard links and inode link-count refcounting through the VFS
goals.criterion: make test_vfs green: link() creates a second name for a TXFS inode with st_nlink == 2, a write through either name is visible through the other, unlinking one name decrements st_nlink to 1 and keeps the data, and the final unlink frees the inode and its extents (free-space count returns to the pre-create value); link() across filesystems returns EXDEV and link() to a directory returns EPERM

goals.title: portable snapshot export/import stream for cross-host migration
goals.criterion: make test_snapshot green: a snapshot of a 10,000-file tree exports to a single stream that a second host imports and diffs to zero changed files; the stream carries COW extent references not raw data for shared blocks; an interrupted import resumes from the last complete record without duplicating files

goals.title: relatime/lazy atime policy for inode timestamp updates
goals.criterion: make test_vfs green: under the default relatime policy a read does not update atime when atime >= mtime and atime is younger than 24 h, and does when either condition fails; a strictatime mount updates on every read; a noatime mount never writes atime; the write is coalesced so a 1000-read loop issues at most one metadata write

goals.title: In-kernel BSD socket object layer: socket/bind/listen/accept/connect on kernel fds, no host passthrough
goals.criterion: make test_socket green: AF_INET SOCK_STREAM bind/listen/accept/connect roundtrip entirely on kernel fds with zero host syscall passthrough; EADDRINUSE and ECONNREFUSED errno paths exercised

goals.title: IPv4 output path: header build, checksum, longest-prefix route lookup, netdev dispatch
goals.criterion: make test_ip green: 20-byte header checksum verified over 64 random payloads; a packet to each of 8 routes lands on the correct netdev with the right next-hop MAC

goals.title: Kernel UDP: port demux, datagram send/recv, pseudo-header checksum
goals.criterion: make test_udp green: 8-byte datagram loopback under 10us; checksum 0 transmitted as 0xFFFF per RFC 768; receive on an unbound port yields ICMP port-unreachable

goals.title: TCP connection state machine: SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK handshake, ESTABLISHED, FIN teardown, TIME_WAIT 2MSL
goals.criterion: make test_tcp green: handshake + data + 4-way close trace matches the RFC 793 state diagram on every transition; simultaneous close reaches CLOSED; TIME_WAIT expires after 2*MSL

goals.title: TCP receive side: segment reordering, in-window acceptance, receive-window advertisement
goals.criterion: make test_tcp_rx green: a reversed 16-segment burst reassembled in order; out-of-window segment ACKed without state corruption; advertised window shrinks under socket backpressure

goals.title: Own C11 AES-128/256 core plus GCM AEAD with AESNI fast path (no OpenSSL)
goals.criterion: make test_gcm green: NIST GCM test cases 1-18 byte-exact including 16-byte tag verify; AESNI table-driven path selected when CPUID reports AESNI

goals.title: Own C11 TLS 1.2 record layer plus handshake state machine
goals.criterion: make test_tls green: handshake against a recorded server transcript completes; record fragmentation/rekey pass; AES-GCM record decrypt byte-exact; no OpenSSL symbol in the link map

goals.title: X.509 DER certificate parse and chain verification with RSA signature check
goals.criterion: make test_x509 green: DER walk of a real 3-cert chain verifies signatures and validity windows; expired and self-signed leaves rejected; SAN dNSName match resolves the host

goals.title: TCP retransmit timer with Karn/Jacobson RTT estimator and RTO backoff
goals.criterion: make test_tcp_rtt green: injected 200ms RTT converges RTO to within 10%; a dropped segment retransmits once not twice per Karn's algorithm

goals.title: TCP zero-window probe and persist timer
goals.criterion: make test_tcp_zwp green: peer window 0 probes every 500ms doubling to 60s; send resumes on the window update; a 60s soak deadlocks zero times

goals.title: TCP keepalive: SO_KEEPALIVE with idle/interval/count sockopts
goals.criterion: make test_tcp_ka green: idle=2s intvl=1s cnt=3 tears down a dead peer at ~5s; all three values readable back via getsockopt; idle=0 disables

goals.title: TCP urgent data (MSG_OOB) with URG pointer semantics
goals.criterion: make test_tcp_oob green: the out-of-band byte is readable at the mark via recv(MSG_OOB); SO_OOBINLINE placement follows RFC 6093 and is togglable by setsockopt

goals.title: TCP listen backlog accept queue with SYN-queue overflow and SYN cookies
goals.criterion: make test_tcp_listen green: backlog=8 with 32 SYNs queues 8 and cookie-replies the rest; accept() drains FIFO; listen(0) returns EINVAL

goals.title: IPv4 fragmentation and reassembly with a 3s fragment timer
goals.criterion: make test_ip_frag green: a 3000-byte datagram split into 3 fragments reassembles in any arrival order; a partial set is dropped after 3s; MF and offset fields follow RFC 791

goals.title: ICMPv4: echo reply, destination/port unreachable, frag-needed
goals.criterion: make test_icmp green: ping echoes with matching id/seq; a closed UDP port returns port-unreachable quoting 8 bytes; inbound checksum verified and bad ones dropped

goals.title: ARP cache with negative entries and neighbor solicitation retry
goals.criterion: make test_arp green: a resolved entry caches 60s then refreshes; 3 failed probes reach INCOMPLETE with 1s base backoff; gratuitous ARP updates an existing entry

goals.title: poll() and select() over kernel socket fds with a readiness bitmap
goals.criterion: make test_poll green: POLLIN fires on data arrival; the select() 3-fdset path agrees with poll on 1024 fds; a 1s timeout returns 0 with no false wakeups

goals.title: Kernel epoll: create/add/mod/del/wait with edge and level trigger
goals.criterion: make test_epoll green: EPOLLIN|EPOLLET delivers once per arrival; level mode re-reports; wait() over 10k registered fds returns in under 1ms

goals.title: 9P2000 msize negotiation with oversize-message Rerror guard (DONE)
goals.criterion: make test_styx_msize green: TVERSION 8192 against a 4096 server negotiates 4096; a 5000-byte TWRITE returns Rerror and leaves the stream in sync for the next message

goals.title: 9P fid lifecycle: Tattach/Twalk/Tclunk/Tremove with a fid leak guard
goals.criterion: make test_styx_fid green: 10k attach/walk/clunk cycles leave 0 live fids; a twice-clunked fid returns Rerror; Tremove implies clunk and frees the fid

goals.title: 9P2000 over a real socket stream transport: length-prefixed frames, torn-read safe
goals.criterion: make test_styx_sock green: client and server over an AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM pair exchange 5k messages with zero framing desync; a 1-byte-at-a-time write pattern reassembles identically

goals.title: DNS stub resolver over UDP: A/AAAA/CNAME chase with search-domain sweep
goals.criterion: make test_dns green: one query returns A plus a chased CNAME; the search list tries app.<domain> first; NXDOMAIN is distinguished from SERVFAIL; 2s timeout with 2 retries

goals.title: HTTP/1.1 client over own TLS: chunked bodies, keep-alive, redirects, Host header
goals.criterion: make test_http green: GET over wubu_tls returns 200 with the chunked body assembled; a 301 is followed to depth 3; a 404 surfaces the status line as an error

goals.title: OCI registry image pull over own HTTPS: v2 API, Bearer token auth, manifest to blobs
goals.criterion: make test_oci_pull green: a 3-layer manifest pulls over wubu_tls writing blobs by sha256 digest; a 401 triggers the token dance then retry; a digest mismatch aborts the pull

goals.title: NAT conntrack table: SNAT/DNAT 5-tuple translation with idle aging
goals.criterion: make test_nat green: container 10.0.0.2:1234 NATs out and its reply DNATs back; idle entries age out at 30s; a port collision falls back to a new source port

goals.title: Network namespace kernel object: per-netns socket/route/arp tables plus enter and leave
goals.criterion: make test_netns green: sockets in ns A are invisible in ns B; a route added in ns A is absent from ns B; an unshare/enter roundtrip restores the identical table

goals.title: Socket-to-9P bridge: serve a 9P session over a TCP socket
goals.criterion: make test_styx_bridge green: a remote 9P client mounts and reads /n/kernel/scheduler over TCP through wubu_tls; read/write/stat roundtrip byte-identical to the local path

goals.title: Remote /n mount client: Tattach/Twalk/Topen/Tread against a peer server
goals.criterion: make test_styx_peer green: /n/remote/<host> shows the peer's tree; a 64KB file read in msize chunks matches the local copy's sha256

goals.title: Peer discovery: mDNS/SSD broadcast responder and peer registry
goals.criterion: make test_p2p_disc green: two instances on one subnet discover each other within 2s over UDP 5353; the registry lists hostname/addr/9P port; a vanished peer drops at its 30s TTL

goals.title: Distributed namespace: write-through replication of an /n subtree to N peers
goals.criterion: make test_p2p_repl green: a write to /n/replicated/x lands on 3 peers; a downed peer queues and drains on return; conflicts resolve last-writer-wins by vector clock

goals.title: Virtual interfaces: TUN/TAP create with packet inject and read
goals.criterion: make test_tun green: a TAP device delivers a 1500-byte frame to a reader and accepts a written frame on the rx path; TUN mode hands over an IP packet, not an Ethernet frame

goals.title: veth pair creation and cross-netns move via netlink
goals.criterion: make test_veth green: a veth pair is created, one end moved into a container netns, both set up; ping across the pair succeeds inside the netns

goals.title: TCP congestion control: slow start, NewReno cwnd growth, dupack fast retransmit and recovery
goals.criterion: make test_tcp_cong green: cwnd doubles per RTT in slow start then grows linear +1/RTT; 3 dupacks trigger fast retransmit and halve cwnd to ssthresh; a 100-packet-loss run still completes the transfer

goals.title: TCP Nagle algorithm and delayed ACK with TCP_NODELAY override
goals.criterion: make test_tcp_nagle green: default mode coalesces two 1-byte writes into one segment; TCP_NODELAY flushes each write immediately; delayed ACK holds at most 40ms or coalesces 2 ACKs

goals.title: UDP multicast: IP_ADD_MEMBERSHIP/IP_DROP_MEMBERSHIP and IGMP report
goals.criterion: make test_udp_mcast green: a member socket receives the multicast datagram and a non-member does not; leave stops delivery within one query interval; an IGMPv2 report goes out on join

goals.title: SO_REUSEADDR/SO_REUSEPORT plus kernel port allocation with bind races
goals.criterion: make test_socket_reuse green: two REUSEADDR listeners on one port both accept; REUSEPORT distributes by hash; a non-reuse second bind returns EADDRINUSE with zero races in 10k iterations

goals.title: AF_UNIX stream socketpair in the kernel socket layer
goals.criterion: make test_unix green: socketpair() yields a bidirectional kernel socket pair with no netdev; a 1MB transfer over it completes; SOCK_SEQPACKET message boundaries are preserved

goals.title: Firewall and conntrack rule engine: 5-tuple match with stateful established accept
goals.criterion: make test_fw green: a 200-rule set matches in under 5us; an ESTABLISHED flow bypasses the INPUT chain; default DROP blocks a new inbound SYN; per-rule hit counters increment

goals.title: Packet capture ring buffer with a BPF-style filter
goals.criterion: make test_pcap green: a 64KB ring captures 100k pps for 1s with no drops at 256 frames; a 'tcp port 80' filter admits only matching frames; captured bytes equal the on-wire bytes

goals.title: IPv6: UDPv6 pseudo-header checksum, RA address autoconfiguration, neighbor discovery
goals.criterion: make test_ipv6 green: a UDPv6 pseudo-header checksum matches a captured packet; an RA yields a global address in the prefix; ND resolves a neighbor and replaces a stale entry

goals.title: TLS session resumption: session-id cache and ticket store
goals.criterion: make test_tls_sess green: a second handshake on a cached session completes in 1 RTT; a ticket expires at its configured lifetime; a tampered ticket is rejected

goals.title: TLS SNI and ALPN extension encode/decode in ClientHello and ServerHello
goals.criterion: make test_tls_ext green: the SNI hostname roundtrips through extension parse; ALPN picks h2 from the offered list; an unknown extension is preserved verbatim on re-encode

goals.title: TLS 1.3 key schedule: HKDF-Expand-Label, transcript hash, traffic-key derivation

goals.title: Landlock ruleset builder with ABI v1..v4 negotiation

goals.title: Compiled seccomp-bpf program verifier

goals.title: Audit records flushed to KV-FS with monotonic sequence across reboot

goals.title: TPM 2.0 PCR measurement of loaded kernel modules

goals.title: Per-process capability ceiling enforced at tasking fork and exec (DONE)

goals.title: WUBU_CAP_FLAG_IMMORTAL kernel-only revocation enforcement

goals.title: Capability handle-table slot exhaustion and reuse policy

goals.title: Capability token marshalling for cross-process transfer

goals.title: AES-NI and SHA-NI runtime dispatch with scalar fallback parity

goals.title: AES-GCM nonce-misuse rejection

goals.title: Authenticated 9P wire frames (ChaCha20-Poly1305 over the styx connection)

goals.title: PID and mount namespace child isolation hardening

goals.title: User-namespace uid/gid mapping for unprivileged container root

goals.title: no_new_privs pinning for sandboxed exec

goals.title: Landlock ruleset represented as a revocable wubu_cap object

goals.title: Syscall-entry security reference monitor for VSL syscalls

goals.title: Audience-gated bootcap installation per boot realm

goals.title: Seccomp profile registry capacity and config-file profile loading

goals.criterion: make test_hw_nvme_admin green: a 40 KiB transfer from a 4 KiB-aligned buffer yields PRP1 = page 0, PRP2 = a PRP-list page holding 9 further page addresses with the total data length accounted for; the list page is 4096-aligned and allocated from the DMA pool

goals.title: FLUSH/FUA write-barrier ordering through the block queue
goals.criterion: make test_blk green: after 8 queued writes, wubu_blk_barrier() returns only once wubu_blk_wb_flush() has drained every write; a FUA-flagged request is dispatched ahead of later non-FUA requests and a barrier between them reorders correctly

goals.title: DMA bounce buffer for devices with a 32-bit DMA mask
goals.criterion: make test_hw_dma green: a source buffer at a >4 GiB address with a 32-bit-mask device is copied through a bounce window below 4 GiB, the destination byte count matches, and the bounce mapping is released on completion; a device with a 64-bit mask takes the zero-copy path

goals.title: VT-d root table + context-entry init, and DMA-remap fault-log drain
goals.criterion: make test_iommu green: the root table is installed at the DMAR base, a context entry for bus 0 dev 2 fn 0 binds the domain, an injected fault record is drained by wubu_iommu_fault_drain() returning source id + fault reason, and the fault-status register is cleared afterward

goals.title: ACPI table checksum verification + XSDT vs RSDT selection by revision
goals.criterion: make test_acpi green: a FADT with a corrupted checksum makes wubu_acpi_parse_fadt() return -1; with a valid checksum and revision >= 2 the XSDT (64-bit entry) path is chosen, and the RSDT path is chosen for revision 1 — both locate the same FADT

goals.title: HPET discovery + PM1a SLP_TYPx shutdown write from the FADT
goals.criterion: make test_hpet green: the HPET base address is read from the synthetic table and the main counter advances monotonically across 1000 reads; writing the S5 sleep type decoded from the synthetic DSDT _S5 into PM1a_CNT halts the fake machine state machine

goals.title: Per-CPU vector allocation from the IDT free range + IRQ affinity binding
goals.criterion: make test_hw_apic green: 24 vectors allocated for 3 NVMe completion queues on 3 CPUs produce no overlap in the IDT free range, and each queue's affinity pins its vector so the injected completion is delivered on the bound APIC id

goals.title: Framebuffer console scroll + dirty-rect diff for the Win98 shell repaint
goals.criterion: make test_hw_fbcon green: an 80x25 scroll copies 24 rows upward and clears the last; the dirty-rect set after a single glyph change contains exactly one 8x8 tile and the repaint loop issues exactly one blit

goals.title: Vulkan compute dispatch of wubunos-generated SPIR-V through the compute queue
goals.criterion: make test_hw_compute green: a 256-element vector-add SPIR-V module (built by wubunos gauntlet fib-style pipeline) dispatched through wubu_compute_submit() returns the golden output vector element-for-element; make test_hw_computectx green reports the queue family used

goals.title: /dev/dxg D3D12 shared-surface interop for the hosted WSL2 leg
goals.criterion: make test_hw_drv_gpu green: a Vulkan image exported through the /dev/dxg handle is imported as a D3D12 resource and a blit result matches the software reference within one ULP; on a non-WSL2 host the path returns 0 without opening /dev/dxg

goals.title: NPU compute-queue submission with out-of-order completion polling
goals.criterion: make test_hw_computectx green: 8 NPU graphs submitted in order complete in the injected order (7,2,0,5,...) and wubu_computectx_wait() returns each in submission order; a timeout on a hung graph surfaces a non-zero error without wedging the queue

goals.title: NPU queue-full graceful degradation to the CPU/llvmpipe compute backend
goals.criterion: make test_hw_compute green: with the NPU queue saturated, wubu_compute_submit() falls back to the software backend, results match the NPU path within the documented tolerance, and the fallback counter increments once per rerouted dispatch

goals.title: HDA codec verb path: CORB/RIRB commands + DAC-to-pin widget discovery and unmute
goals.criterion: make test_hw_drv_hda green: GET_PARAMETER verbs over CORB/RIRB return the injected node count, the DAC-to-pin widget path is found, the pin's amp/mute verb is unmuted, and wubu_drv_hda_last_verb()/wubu_drv_hda_last_response() report the final verb/response pair

goals.title: PCM ring buffer + BDL double buffering with zero underruns at 48 kHz
goals.criterion: make test_hw_pcmring green: 4 KiB frames alternate between 2 BDL entries, and over 10000 simulated IRQs at 48 kHz the underrun counter stays 0; the write pointer never passes the read pointer plus the buffer capacity

goals.title: DualShock 4 USB HID report mapping: buttons, hat, sticks, analog triggers
goals.criterion: make test_hw_input green: a report-0x01 frame for vendor 0x054C device 0x05C4 with L2 fully pressed and the hat pointing up maps to the canonical button mask, the L2 axis at 255, and hat = 0 (up); wubu_hid_feed_gamepad() pushes exactly one event

goals.title: NVMe asynchronous-event hot-plug rescan: namespace add/remove + blkdev reattach
goals.criterion: make test_hw_nvmehotplug green: injecting an async event changes the namespace count from 1 to 2, wubu_nvmehotplug_is_event() reports it once, and the new namespace registers a block device visible through the /n/dev listing; a remove event detaches it cleanly

goals.title: Per-driver QEMU boot verification matrix (ahci/nvme/xhci/ps2/vgatext bind lines)
goals.criterion: the script boots q35 with -device ahci + ide-hd, an NVMe disk, usb-tablet, and std VGA, then greps the serial log for one bind line per driver ('ahci: port 0', 'nvme: ns1', 'xhci: slot', 'ps2: kbd', 'vgatext: 80x25'); it exits 0 only when all five appear

goals.title: VRAM/GTT allocation with fence-synced eviction under memory pressure
goals.criterion: make test_hw_vram green: allocate 512 MiB of VRAM, force eviction, assert the moved pages land in the GTT path (wubu_vram_ttm()), the fence from wubu_fence.c signals only after the flush, and the evicted buffer's contents are byte-identical after restore

goals.title: PCI config-space 8/16-bit read-modify-write accessors + type-1 header handling
goals.criterion: make test_hw_pci green: an 8-bit write at a byte lane inside a 32-bit word leaves the other three lanes intact (verified by read-back through both the ECAM and the 0xCF8 path), and a type-1 header exposes its secondary/subordinate registers without corrupting the header type

goals.title: Interrupt-storm throttle + spurious-IRQ7 gate on the 8259 PIC leg
goals.criterion: make test_hw_irqstorm green: 100000 synthetic IRQs on one vector inside 1 s trip the throttle, the ISR is masked for the backoff window, and a spurious IRQ7 with no ISR bit set increments only the spurious counter without dispatch

goals.title: PCIe hot-plug surprise removal: driver unbind, MSI-X vector release, no dangling IRQ
goals.criterion: make test_hw_hotplug green: removing a device from the fake bus runs the driver's remove(), frees its MSI-X vectors, and zero further IRQs fire afterward; the registry summary drops the device count by one and the freed BAR windows are returned to the pool
